# camtraptor

camtraptor is an R package to explore and visualize Camera Trap Data
Packages ([Camtrap DP](https://camtrap-dp.tdwg.org/)). It offers a
step-by-step workflow to read Camtrap DP files, filter data of interest,
summarize information (e.g. number of observed species) and visualize
this per deployment on an interactive map. You can also use it to
transform data for analysis in
[camtrapR](https://cran.r-project.org/package=camtrapR).

camtraptor 1.0 updates the internal data model to Camtrap DP 1.0 and
drops support for Camtrap DP 0.1.6. This breaking change is accompanied
by a number of other major changes. See the
[changelog](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/news/index.html#camtraptor-100)
for details.

## Get started

To get started, see:

- [Vignettes](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/articles/): tutorials
  showcasing functionality.
- [Function
  reference](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/index.html):
  overview of all functions.

## Installation

You can install the development version of camtraptor from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("inbo/camtraptor")
```

## Example

Get an overview of the species detected in an example Camera Trap Data
Package dataset:

``` r

library(camtraptor)
#> 
#> Attaching package: 'camtraptor'
#> The following object is masked from 'package:base':
#> 
#>     contributors
x <- example_dataset()
taxa(x)
#> # A tibble: 10 × 5
#>    scientificName     taxonID  taxonRank vernacularNames.eng vernacularNames.nld
#>    <chr>              <chr>    <chr>     <chr>               <chr>              
#>  1 Anas platyrhynchos https:/… species   mallard             wilde eend         
#>  2 Anas strepera      https:/… species   gadwall             krakeend           
#>  3 Ardea              https:/… genus     great herons        reigers            
#>  4 Ardea cinerea      https:/… species   grey heron          blauwe reiger      
#>  5 Aves               https:/… class     bird sp.            vogel              
#>  6 Homo sapiens       https:/… species   human               mens               
#>  7 Martes foina       https:/… species   beech marten        steenmarter        
#>  8 Mustela putorius   https:/… species   European polecat    bunzing            
#>  9 Rattus norvegicus  https:/… species   brown rat           bruine rat         
#> 10 Vulpes vulpes      https:/… species   red fox             vos
```

Filter the observations in the dataset on female mallards (Anas
platyrhynchos) and map the number of recorded individuals for each
deployment location:

``` r

x %>%
  filter_observations(
    scientificName == "Anas platyrhynchos",
    sex == "female"
  ) %>%
  summarize_observations() %>%
  map_summary(feature = "sum_count")
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-3-1.png)

## Relation to other R packages

- [camtrapdp](https://cran.r-project.org/package=camtrapdp) is a core R
  package to read and manipulate Camtrap DPs. camtraptor depends on
  camtrapdp and re-exports a number of functions so that users don’t
  need to load both packages.
- [camtrapR](https://cran.r-project.org/package=camtrapR) is an analysis
  R package for camera trap data. camtraptor initially offered a number
  of functions to transform Camtrap DPs to outputs compatible with
  camtrapR. These have been superseded, because camtrapR now supports
  reading Camtrap DPs.
- [camtrapDensity](https://github.com/MarcusRowcliffe/camtrapDensity) is
  a development R package to run single species random encounter models
  to estimate animal density. camtraptor is a dependency.

- We welcome

  including bug reports.

# Package index

## Read data

- [`read_camtrapdp()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/read_camtrapdp.md)
  : Read a Camera Trap Data Package
- [`example_dataset()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/example_dataset.md)
  : Read the Camtrap DP example dataset
- [`mica`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/mica.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Deprecated datasets in camtraptor
- [`read_camtrap_dp()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/read_camtrap_dp.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Read a Camera Trap Data Package

## Filter data

- [`filter_deployments()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/filter_deployments.md)
  : Filter deployments
- [`filter_media()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/filter_media.md)
  : Filter media
- [`filter_observations()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/filter_observations.md)
  : Filter observations
- [`filter_out_timelapse()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/filter_out_timelapse.md)
  : Filter out timelapse observations

## Explore data

- [`summarize_deployments()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/summarize_deployments.md)
  [`summarise_deployments()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/summarize_deployments.md)
  : Summarize deployments information
- [`summarize_observations()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/summarize_observations.md)
  [`summarise_observations()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/summarize_observations.md)
  : Summarize observations information
- [`get_custom_effort()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_custom_effort.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Get custom effort
- [`get_effort()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_effort.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Get effort
- [`get_n_individuals()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_n_individuals.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Get number of individuals for each deployment
- [`get_n_obs()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_n_obs.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Get number of observations for each deployment
- [`get_n_species()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_n_species.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Get number of identified species for each
  deployment
- [`get_rai()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_rai.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Get Relative Abundance Index (RAI)
- [`get_rai_individuals()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_rai_individuals.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Get Relative Abundance Index (RAI) based on the
  sum of individual counts

## Visualize data

- [`map_summary()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/map_summary.md)
  : Visualize deployments features
- [`map_dep()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/map_dep.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Visualize deployments features

## Create outputs for camtrapR

These functions are deprecated because camtrapR now supports reading
Camera Trap Data Packages.

- [`get_cam_op()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_cam_op.md)
  **\[superseded\]** : Get the camera operation matrix
- [`get_detection_history()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_detection_history.md)
  **\[superseded\]** : Get the detection history of a species
- [`get_record_table()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_record_table.md)
  **\[superseded\]** : Get the record table

## Estimate density

- [`calculate_individual_radius_angle()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/calculate_individual_radius_angle.md)
  : Calculate animal position
- [`calc_animal_pos()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/calc_animal_pos.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Calculate animal position

- [`individuals()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/individuals.md)
  : Get individuals
- [`locations()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/locations.md)
  : Get locations
- [`media()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/media.md)
  [`` `media<-`() ``](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/media.md)
  : Get or set media
- [`observations()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/observations.md)
  [`` `observations<-`() ``](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/observations.md)
  : Get or set observations
- [`taxa()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/taxa.md) : Get
  taxa
- [`get_species()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/get_species.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Get species

- [`add_coordinates()`](https://inbo.github.io/camtraptor/reference/add_coordinates.md)
